faq_a1: Fill in the online account application form. Our team reviews your file and identity document, then confirms the opening.
faq_a2: A valid identity document and proof of address. For a business account, company registration documents are also required.
faq_a3: Use the loan calculator to estimate your monthly payments, then apply in branch or via the contact form. The final decision depends on the review of your file.
faq_a4: Yes: a mobile app, USSD banking and Mobile Money are available for everyday account management.
faq_a5: Via the contact form on this site or in branch. Phone numbers and email addresses will be published once confirmed by the bank.
faq_a6: Yes. This site collects no banking data. Identity documents are handled only by the bank's secure system, and never sold or shared.

leg_privacy_text: This is a showcase site. It collects no banking data and performs no transactions. Only the account application form sends data: your personal information and your ID document, transmitted securely to the bank to review your application.
leg_privacy_text2: ID documents and personal information are transmitted securely, used only to review the application, and never sold or shared with third parties without consent.
leg_terms_text: The contents of this site are provided for information. Product rates, fees and terms are indicative and confirmed by the bank when you subscribe. No real banking transaction can be performed from this site.
